# bugs #3510: The C version of _modulong does not return when the divisor is zero

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3510/
- Category: [No action recommended](../../no-action.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Close as undefined behavior, or add the zero test of the mcs51 assembly version to the C version.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The C version of `_modulong` in `device/lib/_modulong.c` does not return on r17176 when the divisor
is 0. A program with `volatile` operands was run in ucsim. `a % 7` gives the correct remainder, and
`a % 0` never returns. After 1,000,000 simulator steps the program counter is inside `__modulong`.
This was observed for stm8, which is the ticket's port, and for mcs51 with `--model-medium`,
`--model-large`, and `--model-large --stack-auto`.

The mcs51 small model behaves differently, with and without `--stack-auto`. It uses the assembly
versions in the same file, which test the divisor first and return when it is 0. The assembly
versions in `device/lib/_moduint.c` have the same test. `a / 0` returns in every configuration that
was tried.

## Reason

C11 6.5.5 paragraph 5 says that the behavior is undefined when the second operand of `/` or `%` is
zero, so a loop that never ends is conforming. Two maintainers decline a check in the ticket for
that reason.

The ticket does not mention that mcs51 already has both behaviors. A maintainer who prefers one
behavior for all mcs51 models can add the zero test to the C version. The PIC16 library has such a
test in `device/lib/pic16/libsdcc/long/modulong.c`, which the reporter cites. The C versions in
`device/lib/_moduint.c` and `device/lib/_modulonglong.c` contain the same loop. They were read and
not run.
